title: Configuring Business Central Server for outdated versions
summary: Configuring Business Central Server instance settings in outdated versions (2022 release wave 1 and earlier). This page documents how to configure the server after installation using the Admin Tool, PowerShell cmdlets, or by directly editing the CustomSettings.config file. Reference of Business Central Server instance settings for outdated versions (v21 and earlier), including Management Services, Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, Data Encryption, Task Scheduler, Asynchronous Processing, Reports, Query, Extensions, Development, Compatibility, Upgrade, and External Events configurations.
features: Database settings (connection, performance optimization, query hints)
Client services settings (file uploads, compression, timeouts)
SOAP services settings (SSL, message size, concurrency)
OData services settings (paging, endpoints, request queues)
